projects.name: Carrom Crest
projects.desc: Real carrom physics, a story across 21 lands, and rooms for you and friends. Published on Google Play by Suwexa Gaming.
projects.long: Carrom Crest is a carrom board game for Android built in Godot 4. Coins slide, collide and rebound with custom physics rather than canned animations. A computer opponent plans real shots by simulating candidate strikes with the same physics and scoring them against the rules. Players can take on a World Tour story across 21 lands, solve challenges, or play friends in online rooms (a small Cloudflare relay joins phones by a 6-digit code) or over the same Wi-Fi with no internet. Built with AI-assisted development (Claude Code): I designed the game and directed the build, and I'm now learning the Godot code behind it.

projects.name: Humanora
projects.desc: An AI writing and study workspace that edits AI-assisted drafts into natural prose while keeping every figure, date and quotation intact.
projects.long: Humanora rewrites AI-assisted drafts using Google Gemini, then runs a meaning check to confirm that the facts, figures and citations survived the rewrite. Model output is validated before it is used. Around it sits a toolkit: grammar checker, paraphraser, summarizer, quiz generator, fact checker, an AI-detector check, readability scoring, a citation generator, and My Voice, which turns a writer's own samples into a compact style profile that steers each rewrite. It has accounts, a PostgreSQL database and usage-based plans. Built with AI-assisted development (Claude Code): I defined the product and directed the build, and I'm learning how each part works.
